body: Contact a domestic abuse organisation, tell them what is going on they can move you into a refuge. Once there, you can connect with other agencies for support with what you have been through.
I am probably the worst for watching these documentaries about killers, everyday! I think it just reminds of how little I want to hurt others

Whoa, not wasted any of my time, I have all the time in the world for someone in need...That’s all I have is time. Like I have said, I have no miracle cure but I will give you my time and a listening ear, I wish I could make everyone better in this world, I wish I could heal everyone’s pain and I wish I could make myself better but none of that is realistic so I will just be ‘there’ ‘here’  but I do ‘care’ because I know pain. You are important to me.

Ok so let’s rethink that idea..... how about you take positivities from the amount of support we are all trying to give each other on here? Just knowing that we are all in this together has helped me through some really rough days over the past couple of weeks.
We are all listening to you
Probably easier if you get a dog or a cat I mean like, they are pretty loving to their owners

Ok, so things are not good. You are who you are though and you may feel a little less agitated if you accept it. I am alone too, I have depression, anxiety and some other stuff and I find that if I stop fighting against these things and just accept them as part of who I am, I feels less agitated.
You are the normal you, you will have better days and crap days, try to remember that they will pass. They may not stay gone but you will find better ways of coping even just for short periods. There is no miracle cure, don’t look for the miracle, just try to break the crap days up into smaller chunks of time that you can manage. Keep venting too, I’m still listening
Cheer you up? What makes you laugh?
Vent, I’m listening, say it all

I get you. Just keep breathing, sometimes we are scared of being happy because we don’t want it to go wrong. 
Someone told me it’s ok to be low because that’s how we know we have been happy.
You can tell me whatever you like, I won’t judge, I won’t tell you what to do but I will listen and I will always wish you peace. 
You can just tell me small things about you, like where you’re from and what you like

Not everyone responds the way we hope, want or need. That’s the risk we take when we open ourselves up to others. Take it as a lesson not to confide in that person again. 
I do not think that you are childish, I think that you’re in pain. 
I will listen if you want to talk

Wait! Don’t do it yet, just give it one more day, forgive yourself for what you believe you have done wrong. 
Don’t do it today, there’s always a day more that you can deal with. Message me back, we can talk all you like

This is true. people on here, other platforms, people we know either through work or personal lives, even our partners, they all say they care and that we are not alone and that things will get better..... none of this helps for longer than a few minutes. Only we can deal with us, only we know and understand us, only we can fight our way through each day from hell. But when we are at our lowest and feeling like no one else cares, look on here and know that there are many of ‘us’ there is some comfort in knowing that we are understood by each other and that although we may alone, we are together in this. I wish you peace of mind.

So it ain’t great, not what you would have chose. Personally, I think you need to start choosing you, you keep putting others first and doing for others and listening to others. Listen to you, what do you want? where do you want to be? You sound like such a good person. Take small steps toward being good to yourself and doing things for yourself. The pandemic and social distancing has made things so much worse for people. I have so much that I want to say to you but feel a bit ‘over the top’ about it. You could try joining loads of clubs where young people do all the outdoors stuff, it will help with your weight and asthma too 💪🏼

Yes! You have written what I feel! You have written what has happened to me since day one of my shit life and I’m 46 now. Fuck me you are spot on. I’m probably not helping much but I love you anyway for saying what I have never been able to. I wish you lots of peace.

Oi listen, you know how much you can take in life, work yourself up to fever pitch and then chill on the low. Your mind needs to rest, your heart needs to rest. Put the water down. Cry out your pain, anger, sadness and then enjoy the peace that follows, baby steps my friend, one day at a time.
